TASK_RECONCILIATION.TASK: No per-object wave script authority; Wave_Math_Scanner flags frame-loop Mathf.Sin, Mathf.Cos, and new float arrays.
CPU DataVault route is the buoyancy authority; GPU, Crest, and async readbacks remain non-authority presentation or sibling routes.
Hot DTOs use unmanaged public fields and explicit offsets; no get/set metadata state in analytical payloads.
AnalyticalGerstnerWaveLayout validates sizes and key offsets with UnsafeUtility and Marshal.OffsetOf.
GenerateMockWaveSpectrumJob and guarded mock requests provide CI fallback without weather ownership.
EvaluateAnalyticalWavesJob is Burst deterministic, IJobParallelFor, DataVault-backed, and NoAlias annotated.
Surface normals come from accumulated analytical slopes, not finite-difference neighbor samples.
No inverse Gerstner solve; requested XZ is the buoyancy truth column.
GlobalQualityWeight maps through smoothstep to octave budget, trig order, coarse macro-grid use, and fractional octave weight.
Four sample lanes are evaluated per job index with float4 phase math and packed four-wave rows.
BuildMacroSwellGridJob caches low-octave swell for coarse lanes; full solver is skipped for all-coarse groups.
SampleAUP minus LocalOriginAUP is done in double, then absolute phase is reconstructed by origin projection modulo wavelength.
Requests/results/telemetry include origin shift proof fields and remain blittable fixed-size rows.
High-volume Vault buffers use uninitialized allocation where jobs overwrite scheduled rows.
A 300-entry WaveMathTelemetryEntry ring and Dump_SHINOBU_263.bin fault route exist.
UI Toolkit tuner writes tuning through Vault locks; runtime serialized fields have tooltips.
Data/Physics/ocean_wave_spectra.csv feeds WaveSpectrumProfileDTO through a ReadOnlySpan<byte> parser that fails closed on trailing garbage.
OnDrawGizmos is editor-only and consumes cached origin snapshot plus result rows for debug visualization.
Wave_Math_Scanner writes SHINOBU_263 and shared physics optimization JSON without deleting sibling data.
This XML, status file, rationale file, LOG file, route card, ledger, and JSON reports document the route. Unity/Burst compile proof is not claimed.

SCALABILITY_CURVE.GLOBAL_QUALITY_WEIGHT: At GlobalQualityWeight below 0.3 the octave budget resolves near the dominant swell plus one fractional transitional octave, coarse macro-grid sampling handles low-priority probes, and polynomial sine/cosine uses the low-order path. From middle tiers the smoothstep budget fades in additional octaves without row popping. High and Ultra reach full octave amplitude, denser debug visibility, and preserved storm weighting. Quality never changes BufferID identity, DTO layout, save identity, or owner route.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.NOALIAS_FIELDS: Spectrum, Requests, Results, MacroGrid, Counters, TelemetryRing, and TelemetryCursor are passed as separate NativeArray fields with NoAlias where used by Burst kernels.

COMPILE_GUARD.ASSEMBLY_ROUTING: SHINOBU_263 adds physics buoyancy files only and does not add sibling runtime assembly references. It routes through Hecton8.Core.Memory contracts, GlobalDataVault, cached origin listener data, and fixed DataVault BufferIDs.

DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.CHEAT: No inverse Gerstner horizontal displacement solve is executed for buoyancy. Requested AUP XZ is treated as the physical query column, while visual water can remain richer in rendering-owned systems.
DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.COMPLEXITY: The macro grid further collapses low-priority lanes to O(1) bilinear lookup after cache construction.

GLOBAL_SYSTEMS_DOCTRINE.FACT: CPU analytical buoyancy height, normal, displacement, flags, and origin shift sequence.
GLOBAL_SYSTEMS_DOCTRINE.READ_ACCESSOR_PURITY: Read/resolve helpers do not publish, search scene state, allocate managed buffers, or call direct JobHandle.Complete.
